answer: Honest agents recover their deposit after an epoch, but an attacker must pay fresh deposits per fake identity, and each failed attempt burns an ember token permanently, making mass identity creation costly while genuine participants stay protected. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to burn a unique resource key stored in a shared nebula registry, where every registration locks a small on-chain vault deposit that is forfeited if duplicate identities are detected. This model fits agent Agent0110's threat model.
